description: A light survey quad with a floodlamp under its sensor. Launch it and stand still at its laptop: you fly it with your movement keys and the camera follows it up to 45 m away, lighting the ground under it while its radar (28 m around it) marks terrain, ore and hostiles for you and your party. Moving or getting hit drops the link and it flies home. Draws 0.55 energy a second from your worn cell, 2:30 a flight. Needs Tech 5. Relay Nine stock; Rask sells it in Dustline.
